text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Normally she would raise her voice in frustration, but... perhaps due to the unexpected losing streak, she has fallen quiet.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...The folks running and the folks watching, they must've all thought it, huh?
That I'm just a total rookie.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...... What's that supposed to mean?
Are you saying I'm weak right now?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk. It pisses me off every single time.
The way you talk...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...... I'm going for a run.
Can't get rid of this irritation otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...I'll run. I'll just keep...
running forever. Until this rage disappears from my chest...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City walked out in tears—
but in her slightly bloodshot eyes, there was a definite spark.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
“...Of course I hate it...
How could I not...?!”
choice_data_list: Right! Your true ability goes way beyond this!
Right! Your true ability goes way beyond this!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Damn it!! ...I won't lose again!
I'll do it! Just you watch me do it!!"
